verdict.rationale: Ramp supports event-driven automation via webhooks (real-time notifications on events), rules-based workflow routing (procurement, approvals, notifications by amount/role), spend controls/funds with programmable restrictions, and policy-driven auto-approval/auto-categorization triggered by transaction events. Combined with agent/CLI/MCP access, users can define conditions that trigger automated actions (approve, flag, route, reimburse) without manual intervention. Missing for 10: a dedicated 'if-this-then-that' custom rules engine UI/API for arbitrary event-action bindings, and independent third-party corroboration of webhook-triggered automation reliability in production.
